args.name: Grand Canyon Poster Billboard by Golden Gate Bridge

style.prompt: Edit the first image (Golden Gate Bridge photograph) to add a realistic freestanding roadside billboard by the bridge, on the right side of the scene. Display the exact Grand Canyon vintage poster from the second image on a portrait-format billboard panel, preserving its full artwork, original colors, border, lettering and proportions without cropping. Make the billboard large enough to clearly see the poster, but do not obscure the central bridge tower. Add plausible metal framing and supports anchored by the roadside, matched perspective, daylight, shadows and photographic detail. Preserve the original bridge, traffic, water and landscape as much as possible. The result should look like a natural photograph of this poster installed on a billboard beside the Golden Gate Bridge.
